# Online experiments

Online studies can make it possible to recruit and test participants remotely, but require careful attention to participant experience, data quality, privacy, and technical compatibility.

## Before building a study

- Confirm ethics approval covers the platform, recruitment, and data collected.
- Choose the institutionally approved survey or experiment platform.
- Test the study on supported browsers and screen sizes.
- Make consent, withdrawal, and contact information clear to participants.
- Plan exclusion and quality checks before collecting data.

## Open a gorilla account

Create an account in gorilla <https://app.gorilla.sc/> and make sure you have access to the experimental task you will use.

Here you can find all the information needed to understand how to use Gorilla <https://support.gorilla.sc/support/>

## Get familiar with prolific

Please get familiar with the prolific platform <https://www.prolific.com/>.

Here you can find some information about prolific and how to set up experiments <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JuSSVqEeLkE&ab_channel=BehavioralScienceExplained> <https://www.cognition.run/tutorial/prolific-online-platform>
